summary.text: Ken Rozenboom is a Republican who represents District 19 in the Iowa Senate, according to the Iowa Legislature's member page.

That page lists Ken Rozenboom's General Assembly service beginning with the term that started in 2013, and its current standing committee assignments include Agriculture (Vice Chair), Education, Natural Resources and Environment, Rules and Administration, State Government (Chair), and Transportation.
The page identifies Ken Rozenboom as vice chair of Agriculture and chair of State Government.
